summary: The Policy outlines the terms and conditions for Credit Management and Credit Limits, including the Insurer's Liability, Credit Limit, and Maximum Liability. It also covers the Insured's obligations, such as exercising reasonable care and prudence in granting credit, and complying with any instructions from the Insurer. The Policy specifies the conditions for reducing or terminating cover, including deterioration of the risk or material cause. It also outlines the procedures for increasing or decreasing the Credit Limit, including the use of the Preliminary limit and the Limit of discretional increase. Additionally, the Policy covers the sharing of Credit limits with affiliated companies and the application of insurance liability retroactively to certain Contracts.

title: 5. DECLARATION AND PREMIUM
key_items: 5.1 The Premium payable by the Insured is calculated by reference to the Insured's insurable Turnover.
5.3 Insurance premium (including any installment according to Item 5.2) will be payable in Indian Rupees.
5.5 It is a condition precedent to the Insurer's liability to the Insured under the Policy that total declarations must be received by the Insurer no later than 60 days after the Policy expiry date.
5.7 On receipt of the Insured's declaration, the Insurer will calculate the Premium earned under the Policy.
5.8 Payment of the Premium including first insurance installment in accordance with Items 5.2, and 5.7 above is a condition precedent to the Insurer's liability to the Insured under the Policy.
summary: This policy outlines the terms and conditions for trade credit insurance, including premium calculation, payment, and declaration requirements. The insured must pay the basic premium, declare their insurable turnover, and notify the insurer of any insolvency or non-payment of commercial credit. The insurer will calculate the premium earned and invoice the insured for any due premium. The policy also outlines the conditions for a no claims bonus and the insurer's liability for goods dispatched or services rendered.

It also covers recoveries, claims, and subrogation of rights against counterparty and third parties. The policy requires strict compliance with its terms and conditions, and breach of these terms may result in deterioration of risk and voiding of the policy.

title: 7. COLLECTIONS
key_items: 7.1. The Insurer shall be subrogated into the rights of the Insured towards the Counterparty and third parties responsible for the loss indemnified hereunder to the amount of indemnity paid.
7.2. The Insured shall pass to the Insurer all the documents and proofs and advise the Insurer of all the information required to exercise its respective rights.
summary: This policy outlines the terms and conditions of trade credit insurance, including the Insurer's liability, the Insured's responsibilities, and the process for submitting and paying claims. It also covers the consequences of false or fraudulent claims and the reduction of claim amounts by set-off, counterclaims, and other factors.

nodes.summary: This policy outlines the terms and conditions of trade credit insurance, including the Insurer's liability, the Insured's obligations, claim procedures, and payment terms. The policy requires the Insured to take reasonable measures to prevent loss and minimize it, and to provide all necessary documents and information to the Insurer. The Insurer shall be subrogated into the rights of the Insured and shall pay insurance indemnity in proportion to the insured percentage. The policy also outlines the procedures for making claims, including the submission of a complete claim in writing within 60 days after the Date of Loss, and the reduction of the claim amount by any set-off, counterclaims, payments recovered or the proceeds from relevant sales of goods.

title: 15. MISCELLANOUS
key_items: 15.1. All annexes specified herein are integral parts hereof.

15.5. The Parties shall be liable for accuracy of legal addresses and banking details provided in the Policies and undertake to notify each other of any changes thereto.
15.6. Other issues not stipulated herein shall be resolved in accordance with the current legislation of the Republic of India.
15.8 Any modification or amendment to the terms and conditions of the Policy is valid only when accompanied by a written approval from the Insurer.

15.9 If the Insured wishes to renew the Policy due to its Period of Cover expiration, the Insured shall complete a Proposal therefore prior to the date falling 30 (thirty) days before the expiry date.

summary: This policy outlines the terms and conditions of trade credit insurance, including the suspension of policy cover for failure to provide documents, the release of liability for non-compliance with legal or contractual obligations, and the resolution of disputes through negotiations or the current legislation of the Republic of India. It also covers annexes, amendments, and alterations to the policy, as well as the accuracy of legal addresses and banking details. Additionally, it defines key terms such as 'Contract', 'Credit Limit', and 'Country underwriting attitude'.
